name: Blazing Blood
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than be 20 ft. apart
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You transform a portion of the blood of one or more creatures into a blazing fluid that burns them from the inside. Affected creatures take 1d4 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 20d4). If the creature has ingested wine or other alcohol within the past hour, the damage is raised to 1d6 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 20d6).

Creatures that have no blood, such as undead (other than vampires) or constructs, are immune to this spell.
